options.content: **Dashboard 4 of 4 (Section 12.4). Synthetic-only, and always will be until this changes.** The real gateway has zero visibility into LLM token cost (Phase 3 Day 14's finding: an agent's LLM calls, like `agents/aml-investigator`'s Assessment/Report nodes, happen out-of-process, never through Interpose). Every number here comes from `generate_synthetic_telemetry`'s fabricated `tokens`/cost fields (~15% of rows), aggregated into `agg_cost_daily` -- illustrative volume, not real spend, not real provider pricing. Fixed 2026-07-06 to 2026-08-03 window.

panels.title: Token spend per agent (top 10 by cost)

targets.rawSql:
WITH top_agents AS (
            SELECT agent_id FROM agg_cost_daily
            WHERE source = 'synthetic' AND $__timeFilter(day)
            GROUP BY agent_id ORDER BY sum(cost_usd) DESC LIMIT 10
        )
        SELECT day AS time, agent_id AS metric, sum(cost_usd) AS value
        FROM agg_cost_daily
        WHERE source = 'synthetic' AND $__timeFilter(day)
          AND agent_id IN (SELECT agent_id FROM top_agents)
        GROUP BY day, agent_id
        ORDER BY day

SELECT day AS time, provider AS metric, sum(cost_usd) AS value
        FROM agg_cost_daily
        WHERE source = 'synthetic' AND $__timeFilter(day)
        GROUP BY day, provider
        ORDER BY day

panels.title: Projected monthly cost (at current daily rate)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT avg(daily_cost) * 30 AS value
        FROM (
            SELECT day, sum(cost_usd) AS daily_cost
            FROM agg_cost_daily
            WHERE source = 'synthetic' AND $__timeFilter(day)
            GROUP BY day
        ) per_day

panels.title: Agents exceeding a $5/day illustrative cost threshold

targets.rawSql:
SELECT day, agent_id, round(sum(cost_usd)::numeric, 4) AS cost_usd
        FROM agg_cost_daily
        WHERE source = 'synthetic' AND $__timeFilter(day)
        GROUP BY day, agent_id
        HAVING sum(cost_usd) > 5.0
        ORDER BY cost_usd DESC
